get.summary:
GetEventHistogram counts the events of a kind per time bucket,
resource and key.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description:
- EVENT_KIND_HTTP_INGRESS: Requests received by the edge; keyed by the http status.
 - EVENT_KIND_HTTP_EGRESS: Requests proxied to the origins; keyed by the status of the origin.
 - EVENT_KIND_SEC_RULE: Matched SecRules; keyed by the action.
 - EVENT_KIND_RATE_LIMIT: Exceeded rate limiters; keyed by the action.
 - EVENT_KIND_CORE_RULE: Matched core ruleset rules; keyed by the behavior.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description:
- HISTOGRAM_RESOLUTION_UNSPECIFIED: Picked by from and to: the shortest range holding them but one bucket
(buckets of seconds only within the 7 days they are kept), else 30
days; 1 hour without from.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description:
The buckets end before to (exclusive), else with the current one,
and start at from rounded down to a bucket, else a span of the
resolution before: at most 1000 of them, see the response. from and
to pick the resolution when unspecified.

get.summary:
GetEventTopValues counts the most frequent values of fields of the
events of a kind over a time range, and their share of its events.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description:
- EVENT_KIND_HTTP_INGRESS: Requests received by the edge; keyed by the http status.
 - EVENT_KIND_HTTP_EGRESS: Requests proxied to the origins; keyed by the status of the origin.
 - EVENT_KIND_SEC_RULE: Matched SecRules; keyed by the action.
 - EVENT_KIND_RATE_LIMIT: Exceeded rate limiters; keyed by the action.
 - EVENT_KIND_CORE_RULE: Matched core ruleset rules; keyed by the behavior.

parameters.name: resourceIds
parameters.description: Resources of the events, any of them; all when empty.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description:
Bound the time of the events, from inclusive, to exclusive: to now
when unset, from the hour before to when unset.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
The fields to count, in this order, each once, named as in the event
message of the kind (e.g. client_ip): all those of the kind when empty.
  - http ingress: method, status, host, client_ip, country, protocol,
    path, user_agent.
  - http egress: upstream, status, method, path, content_type,
    protocol.
  - sec rule, rate limit: matched_secrule_ids, action (its type, a
    rule.v1.ActionType number), request_ip, request_domain,
    request_path.
  - core rule: matched_rule_ids, severities, behavior, total_score,
    request_ip, request_domain, request_path.
An event counts once per element of a repeated field it holds.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The values per field: 5 when 0, at most 20.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description:
Field filters, all of them, each "field:value": the events holding
the value in the field, compared in the type of the field (a number
for status; an element of a repeated one). The field is before the first colon, one of those of fields;
the value is the rest, colons and spaces included.

parameters.name: requestIds
parameters.description:
Requests of the events, by request id, any of them (see
ListHttpIngressEventsRequest.request_ids); all when empty.

protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

 The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

v1Action.title: An action to execute when a rule matches

v1ActionType.description:
- ACTION_TYPE_RATE_LIMIT: The request was over a rate limiter and answered 429 Too Many
Requests: the action of the rate limit events, set by the edge; not
one a rule is configured with.

upstream.description:
upstream is the origin the request was sent to, e.g.
http://10.0.0.1:8080.

method.description:
method, scheme, path and queries are the request once proxied: the
path is the client one unless the proxy joined the path of upstream
to it, the scheme is the one of upstream, http or https.

status.description: status is the one the origin answered, 502 when it was unreachable.

contentLength.description:
content_length is the Content-Length the origin answered, -1 when
it streamed the body without one.

latencyMicros.description:
latency_micros is the time the proxy took to relay the request and
the answer of the origin.

timestamp.title: milisec, when the request was sent

protocol.description:
protocol is the HTTP version the client used to reach the edge, e.g.
HTTP/2.0: the one used to reach upstream is not observable.

headers.description:
headers are the request headers the edge set for the upstream, one
"Name: value" line each, sorted by name: X-Forwarded-Prefix, the
proxySetHeaders once their variables are resolved and the SecRule
MODIFY_HEADER ones, without the credential ones.

v1EgressEvent.description:
EgressEvent is the leg of a request from the reverse proxy to its
upstream origin, logged once the origin answered; id is the one of
the request IngressEvent.

v1EventKind.description:
EventKind the table of the events a histogram counts.

 - EVENT_KIND_HTTP_INGRESS: Requests received by the edge; keyed by the http status.
 - EVENT_KIND_HTTP_EGRESS: Requests proxied to the origins; keyed by the status of the origin.
 - EVENT_KIND_SEC_RULE: Matched SecRules; keyed by the action.
 - EVENT_KIND_RATE_LIMIT: Exceeded rate limiters; keyed by the action.
 - EVENT_KIND_CORE_RULE: Matched core ruleset rules; keyed by the behavior.

from.description: Bound the time of the events, from inclusive, to exclusive.

v1EventSelection.description:
EventSelection selects the events of a kind: those of any of the
resources and requests, holding every field filter, in the time range.
The flat resource_ids, request_ids, filters, from and to of the list,
histogram and top values requests mirror it.

v1FieldTopValues.description:
FieldTopValues the most frequent values of a field, the most first;
the empty values are left out.

share.description: total over the events of the range, from 0 to 1.

v1FieldValue.description: FieldValue the events holding a value of a field.

upstreams.description: One per upstream, ordered by upstream.

points.description:
Oldest first, then per resource and key: one per bucket, a total of
0 when it has no event; a resource without any has key 0.

interval.description:
The width of one bucket, that of the resolution asked or picked by
from and to.

from.description: The first bucket starts at from and the last one ends at to.

truncated.description:
The range held more than 1000 buckets: from was moved later so the
latest 1000 are returned.

fields.description: One per field of the request, in its order.

points.description:
Oldest first, then per resource: one per bucket, the key 0, the total
the number of distinct client ips of the bucket, 0 without.

interval.description:
The width of one bucket, that of the resolution asked or picked by
from and to.

from.description: The first bucket starts at from and the last one ends at to.

truncated.description:
The range held more than 1000 buckets: from was moved later so the
latest 1000 are returned.

v1HistogramInterval.description:
HistogramInterval the width of one bucket of a histogram, the one of its
HistogramResolution.

 - HISTOGRAM_INTERVAL_10_SECONDS: Kept 7 days.

key.description: The value of the key of the kind, 0 without.

v1HistogramPoint.description:
HistogramPoint the events of a resource and key in the bucket starting
at time.

v1HistogramResolution.description:
HistogramResolution the time range a histogram charts, ending with the
current bucket or before to: as many buckets of its interval as fill it
(5 minutes of 10 seconds, ..., 30 days of 12 hours).

 - HISTOGRAM_RESOLUTION_UNSPECIFIED: Picked by from and to: the shortest range holding them but one bucket
(buckets of seconds only within the 7 days they are kept), else 30
days; 1 hour without from.

visitors.description: Oldest bucket first, then the client ip of the most requests.

interval.description:
The width of one bucket, that of the resolution asked or picked by
from and to.

from.description: The first bucket starts at from and the last one ends at to.

truncated.description:
The range held more than 1000 buckets: from was moved later so the
latest 1000 are returned.

v1RuleBehavior.description:
- RULE_BEHAVIOR_LOG: Would have been denied, but the engine only detects
(ENGINE_MODE_DETECTION_ONLY).

tags.description: Tags set by the SET_TAG actions of the matched rules.

v1UpstreamLatency.description:
UpstreamLatency the latency of the requests proxied to an upstream, in
microseconds.

v1VisitorPoint.description:
VisitorPoint the requests of a client ip to a resource in the bucket
starting at time.
